formulas.absolute_score: sum(score / max_score * weight) over active criteria (0-100)
formulas.benchmark: highest validated score for the criterion across all suppliers in the run
formulas.gap: supplier score - benchmark (0 for the leader, otherwise negative)
formulas.relative_pct: supplier score / benchmark * 100; 0 when the benchmark is 0
